outline:
This course aims to equip students with advanced 3D modeling and animation skills, guiding them from concept development to final output. Instruction will focus on Blender—an industry-standard tool for animation and visual design—and 3DCoat, a powerful platform for digital sculpting and PBR texturing.
Through a series of hands-on exercises, students will gain practical experience with key tools and workflows, building a strong foundation for entering the design industry.
By semester’s end, students are expected to complete a comprehensive design project, including drawings, renderings, animations, and a fully realized 3D model. This final package will serve as the primary basis for course evaluation.
